property_summary: For any admissible input, c.transfer forwards exactly one transferFrom call to the callee for every destination in _tos, so the callee must observe exactly _tos.length calls; the buggy version skips the last destination and therefore records _tos.length - 1 calls, violating the rule whenever _tos.length > 1.
change_summary: Change the loop condition to compare the counter against the destination array length offset by one, altering which destinations are processed.
